attribution.creator: The Piano Lady (Lena Orsa)
attribution.official_attribution_line: Pistachio Ice Cream Ragtime by The Piano Lady (Lena Orsa), Freesound 442789, CC BY-NC 3.0. First 8 seconds, converted to mono 48 kHz and quantized for the FPGA. Thresholded versions are adaptations.

spectra.display_precision: Captured uint56 powers cast to JS double for display only; archive validation and threshold checks use exact uint64.
spectra.time_scope: Input-window end times. Frame 0 has 128 leading zeros. Final flush frame ends 128 samples after the original 8-second clip.

monitor.reason: No downstream causal-monitor output was recorded for this piano capture.

metrics.byte_scope: Full 8-second finite capture including one flush spectral frame. Sparse and compact dense counts include TSP1 headers and padding, but exclude the separate Y waveform and transport overhead.

audio.normalization: Fixed 8x integer conversion from actual signed12 input and aligned physical Y for every threshold and audio mode. No independent normalization or clipping.
audio.input_reference: Actual signed12 FPGA input, not the earlier prepared PCM16 source.
audio.derivation: Original=input.i32le*8; processed=physical Y[384:384384]*8; difference=(input-aligned Y)*8. No TSP1-based waveform synthesis.

provenance.physical_timing_scope: Archived single-run full 8-second finite transaction. Board service includes HPS PIO/feed/drain stalls; host round trip includes network. Neither is compute-only FPGA time or a matched CPU comparison.
provenance.playback_scope: Archived physical FPGA outputs. Offline export only; no new board run. Time-synchronized playback after finite capture, not a live ADC stream.
provenance.source_preparation: First 8 seconds of pinned 44.1 kHz stereo Ogg, channel mean, polyphase resampling to 48 kHz, fixed gain 0.5, ties-even PCM16 rounding, then ties-even round(PCM16/16) signed12 input.

cpu_timing.scope: No downstream CPU benchmark was recorded for this piano capture.

notes: Piano excerpt by The Piano Lady (Lena Orsa), CC BY-NC 3.0. Attribution and noncommercial license apply to this audio and its adaptations.
Before FPGA is the actual signed12 input at the same fixed playback gain as aligned physical Y. Earlier PCM16 preparation and quantization differences are outside this comparison.
Spectra come from captured TSP1 powers; waveform audio comes from the separate captured Y output.
CPU consumer timing, causal-monitor features, and recorded stage-event history are unavailable for this capture.
